data.name: Garvin
data.gender_notes: Garvin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Garvin is believed to have Old English and Celtic roots. The name is derived from the Old English words 'graf' meaning spear and 'weard' meaning friend. Garvin can be interpreted as 'strong friend' or 'warrior friend'. The name Garvin carries the meaning “Strong, friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Garvin usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes strength and loyalty in friendship and relationships.
data.etymology: Garvin belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Garvin total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

In the Celtic tradition, the name Garvin is believed to be associated with the protection of the household and the community. The name's interpretation as 'warrior friend' signifies bravery, loyalty, and strength – all qualities that are highly valued in many cultures, including those with a warrior tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Garvin holds spiritual significance in the Christian tradition, as it is derived from the Old English words 'graf' and 'weard.' These words symbolize the importance of spiritual protection and the companionship of God. As a Christian name, Garvin can be seen as a reminder of the importance of having faith in God as a strong friend and protector. The name also carries the symbolism of the spear, which can represent the spiritual weapon that Christians use to fight against evil and darkness in the world. Ultimately, the name Garvin can serve as a daily reminder of the strength of God's love and protection, and the importance of living a life guided by Christian values.
